The absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps=true), so the only honest read is de-risking discipline, not return forecasting.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: The only eligible theme besides Banks with a true trend Hurst tag, durability_bar 0.68 (highest of the eligible cohort), uncrowded crowding_z 0.24, and broad-enough breadth 0.6. The absolute-trend gate is validated here, so leaning with the trend leg on the one eligible non-crowded trend is the most defensible conditional.
theses.dissent: Energy (H-shares) has no ETF proxy and is unscorable; breadth 0.6 is only middling cohesion, and the leader Banks is mean-reverting with a crowding flag — if the whole eligible cohort rolls over, Energy lacks the one-narrative floor.

theses.dissent: Banks is the thematic leader and momentum concentration can persist longer than expected; avoiding it forfeits whatever leadership premium remains.

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: The only scorable theme with an ETF proxy (3033.HK), but it is deep ineligible (rank 13, score -0.875, durability_bar 0.34, breadth 0.444). The absolute-trend gate is validated here, so the gate itself says stay out — not a return call, just trend-eligibility discipline.
